senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.2) fermenting wine, wine turned into vinegar.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:14">Lam. R. to III, 40</cite> <he>אין דעולית׳ מרירן בסימא חמיע</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אית כרנבי ב׳ דסימא חמיע</he>; read <he>אין דכר׳</he>, strike out <he>דסימא</he>) when the endive (the cabbage) is bitter, the fermenting wine turns sour (sin begets sin). Cant. R. end, if the vineyard is cut before its time, <he>אפי׳ בִסְמֵיה וכ׳</he> even its vinegar is not good.
